notes:
**Status: approved by Christian on 2026-10-26.** CHR-925 / CHR-907, position revised twice in CHR-929.

**Decision: toast, not banner.** A non-modal toast at the top right, directly below the settings trigger. It is `position:absolute` (fixed in the app) over the UI, so it does not move any layout: topbar (44), variant bar (36) and panel widths are fixed and the canvas frame sizing/zoom depends on the stage height — a banner row would shift the whole canvas each time it appears or is dismissed. A toast is also calm (one dismissible item, no modal), and the persistent copy of the same information lives in the settings menu "About" row (see `shell-settings-menu` notes), so dismissing the toast loses nothing.

**Position (Christian: "This should be in the upper right corner", then "oben rechts unter das Einstellungssymbol und an die rechte Seite. Der Toast darf über Elements liegen").** Same anchor as the settings menu: `position: fixed; top: 48px` (topbar 44 + 4px) and `right: 12px` (the topbar's right padding, $spacing.lg), so its right edge is flush with the settings trigger's right edge (x=1428 at 1440 wide). Width 360px. It overlaps the right panel (Elements) and the variant bar's right end — that is intended. z-index 10, above panels. Because it sits where the settings menu opens, the open menu (z 10, same anchor) replaces/covers it; hide the toast while the menu is open.

**Anatomy.** Padding 12 (right 8), radius.md 10, `chrome-raised`, `chrome-shadow-float`, `role=status` (announced politely, never steals focus). Row: `upgrade` icon 20px `chrome-accent`; column with title "Artisign 2.2.0 is available" (13px medium) and `chrome-code-field` `compact` (28px, mono 12px) `artisign update` with a copy button (`content_copy` -> `check`); close `chrome-icon-btn` sm (`close`) top right, tooltip "Hide for today" drawn below the button (hover state shown), right-aligned to it.

**Behaviour.** Appears once per page load when the daemon reports a newer version; close hides it until the next calendar day (browser-local, stored with the version so a newer release shows it again); no auto-dismiss timer; not shown when the update check is off. The copy icon copies the command only — no update button (updating is a terminal action, `artisign update` restarts the daemon). Dark: same markup with the dark token group at the root.
